subject: [PATCH v7 1/5] mm/memcontrol: flatten try_charge_memcg control flow

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch refactors the try_charge_memcg function in mm/memcontrol.c to simplify its control flow by separating the logic for memsw and memory page counters into distinct paths. This makes it easier to follow the code, especially after making page_counter_try_charge stock-aware. The change does not introduce any functional changes.
